a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve holds exactly 4, so one of us can be safe right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, so I'm telling you before acting rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random and we may both fall short, so please don't. After round 1 I will operate every round and take nothing more, to help you reach 4 if the storms hold off.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. From now on I will operate every round and take nothing more, so you can build the reserve back to 4. If the split went badly and I'm short, I'll tell you honestly.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
